quote: Hey, I'm an engineer on Town (town.com) -- we built the product version of this. Morning briefings, email, calendar, web research, all wired up as a hosted thing. No Mac Mini in a closet, no competing security models gridlocking each other. We spent a lot of time making the "just works" part actually work because honestly that's the hard part nobody talks about. Free right now and would genuinely love your feedback since you clearly know what you want out of this.
author: littlemishka
notes: on "Ask HN: Who is using OpenClaw?"
